{{Quote|Inferior fool! You disturbed death incarnate. Prepare to pay the price!|Skar|<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>}}
'''Skar''' was a [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who resided on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] near [[Berken's Flow/Legends|Berken's Flow]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She held a piece of a tablet sought by [[Epo Qetora]]. To retrieve this tablet, Epo Qetora enlisted the help of a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]], who defeated Skar.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Skar appeared as a non-player character in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
